srList.sentence: Among the significantly enriched taxa (P < 0.05, LEfSe) in the sponge‐associated bacterial community, substrate incorporation was validated based on two criteria: (i) the increasing relative abundance of a taxon in the 13C treatment occurs in at least two consecutive density fractions, with highest abundance in the heaviest of the two fractions, and ii) the relative abundance of the taxon in the 13C treatment is greater than its relative abundance in the 12C treatment in both density fractions.
